GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the letter "ß" pronounced? (1 mark)
   A. like b
   B. like a strong ss
   C. like sh
   D. like z

2. How is the letter Z named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ell
   B. ay
   C. gay
   D. tset

3. Which sound needs rounded lips? (1 mark)
   A. e
   B. ü
   C. i
   D. a

4. What does "die Mutter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brothers and sisters
   B. family
   C. mother
   D. parents

5. In the guessing game, which sentence gives the answer "It is my father"? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist meine Oma.
   B. Das ist mein Vater.
   C. Das ist meine Mutter.
   D. Das ist mein Bruder.

6. Which little word goes with the noun "Tür"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. den
   D. der

7. What does "das Messer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fork
   B. knife
   C. table
   D. bathroom

8. What does "Freunde" mean? (1 mark)
   A. friends
   B. foods
   C. families
   D. days

9. What does "oft" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yesterday
   B. always
   C. often
   D. tomorrow

10. Which month comes right after "März"? (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. April
   C. Juli
   D. September

11. What does "Wie viele Kerzen?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. How many candles?
   B. When is the party?
   C. Which cake?
   D. Who is coming?

12. Which German word is the number 9? (1 mark)
   A. neun
   B. sechs
   C. dreizehn
   D. acht

13. Which food group does "der Tee" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Fleisch
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Obst

14. What does "das Mittagessen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. apple
   B. lunch
   C. milk
   D. potato

15. Which little word goes with the noun "Bein"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

16. What does "Womit sehe ich?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What do I see with?
   B. What do I hear with?
   C. Where do I sleep?
   D. Who is that?

17. What does "warm" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. warm
   B. cool
   C. dry
   D. wet

18. What does "kalt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cold
   B. hot
   C. sunny
   D. cool

19. Which German word means "under"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. unter
   B. hinter
   C. in
   D. über

20. Which German word means "between"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. neben
   B. auf
   C. zwischen
   D. hinter

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Read: "Mein Vater heißt Juma. Er ist groß und nett." Write three facts from the text in English. (3 marks)

22. Say why all nouns in a German text begin with capital letters and how this helps a reader. (2 marks)

23. Complete with the correct verb form: "Mutter ___ (kochen). Vater ___ (lesen). Der Hund ___ (schlafen)." (3 marks)

24. Write the German words with their articles for: fridge, cooker, plate, spoon. (4 marks)

25. Write three healthy foods and two unhealthy foods in German. (3 marks)

26. Write these numbers in German: 3, 7, 11. (3 marks)

27. Write the German sound for each letter group: ei and ie. Give an example word for each. (2 marks)

28. Write the numbers 3, 9 and 12 in German. (3 marks)

29. Make a playful food blend from Mango and Milch, and say what it is. (2 marks)

30. Read: "In Mombasa ist es heiß." Say what it means and how to say heiß. (2 marks)

31. Write these numbers in German: 2, 6, 10. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — like a strong ss
   ß is called Eszett and sounds like ss.

2. D — tset
   In German the letter Z is called tset.

3. B — ü
   To say ü, say ee with round lips as if whistling.

4. C — mother
   die Mutter means mother.

5. B — Das ist mein Vater.
   Vater means father.

6. B — die
   It is die Tür, so the little word is die.

7. B — knife
   das Messer means knife.

8. A — friends
   der Freund is friend and die Freunde is friends.

9. C — often
   oft means often.

10. B — April
   After März comes April.

11. A — How many candles?
   wie viele means how many.

12. A — neun
   9 in German is neun.

13. C — die Getränke
   der Tee belongs to die Getränke.

14. B — lunch
   das Mittagessen means lunch.

15. B — das
   It is das Bein, so the little word is das.

16. A — What do I see with?
   womit means with what.

17. A — warm
   warm means warm.

18. A — cold
   kalt means cold.

19. A — unter
   under in German is unter.

20. C — zwischen
   between in German is zwischen.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: The father is called Juma. He is tall. He is kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a spelling rule. Readers can spot the nouns quickly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the help.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: kocht, liest, schläft.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb form.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kühlschrank, der Herd, der Teller, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Healthy: Obst, Gemüse, Bohnen. Unhealthy: Süßigkeiten, Limonade.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for three healthy foods, 1 mark for two unhealthy foods, 1 mark for correct spelling.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, sieben, elf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: ei sounds like eye (nein). ie sounds like ee (Tier).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound with an example.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mangmil, a mango and milk drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible blend, 1 mark for the explanation.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: In Mombasa it is hot. heiß is said like hice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: zwei, sechs, zehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.
